 j=json.loads(P.read_text()); started=time.time()

 assert actual==s[key+'_sha256'], key+' digest mismatch'
j['fixture_digests_before']={}
for case,root in s['cases'].items():
 j['fixture_digests_before'][case]={}
 for name,expected in s['fixture_digests_before'][case].items():
  actual=hashlib.sha256((pathlib.Path(root)/'.noodle'/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  j['fixture_digests_before'][case][name]=actual
  assert actual==expected, case+'/'+name+' digest mismatch'
assert j['runtime_env']['NOODLE_SESSION_ID'] and j['runtime_env']['NOODLE_ORDER_ID']=='noodle-84' and int(j['runtime_env']['NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX'])==0
save(j)
